trajectory_contrast.interpretation: Lifetime advancement and fixed-window persistence answer different questions. The T+20 major fraction is higher than T+10 in this small political stratum because several selected figures held major national campaign or ministerial roles inside 2024-2026; this is not a monotonic career score and should not be read as cumulative survival.

guardrails: Do not replace lifetime post-selection peak with fixed-time/window snapshot or vice versa.
Death is a competing event; post-death snapshots are null.
Former officeholder labels do not inherit the earlier office score.
A role must fall inside the prespecified snapshot window to count.
This is the politics field-specific secondary stratum, not the whole 60-unit project.
